dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse greyish clusters primarily localized toward the posterior portion of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope with smooth transitions between subtle grey pigmented regions and the off-white baseline.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, centrally-aligned dark elliptical aperture (blowhole) at the anterior apex of the visible dorsal plane.
